definitions.explanation: Sewing done by hand with a needle rather than a sewing machine; with の, describes something sewn by hand.

examples.japanese: {手縫|てぬ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧。
⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手縫|てぬ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I sewed the button on by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦ミシン→ミシン：06365_mishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{雑巾|ぞうきん}→雑巾：04408_zoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手縫|てぬ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I don't have a sewing machine, so I made the cleaning cloths for my child's school by hand.

notes:

- {手縫|てぬ}い⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧: hand-sewing thread
